title: Two different operations whose ids are empty strings
policy: P4: an empty id is a missing id, not an identity shared by every record that has one.
derivation: 16:20Z [100, 50] and 17:20Z [100, 70] are separate operations: 320 tokens in two hours. Today both share the key of id "" + request "": the second only adds its output growth (+20) to the first's hour, giving [100, 70] in hour 16 and 170 tokens.
